proposed_from.topic: Matched minimax frontier for unrestricted optimal-policy value with a high-dimensional discrete confounder. Observe n iid draws of X in [d] and binary A,Y under consistency, conditional exchangeability, and fixed overlap eps. Target Vstar=sum_x p_x max(mu_0x,mu_1x), equivalently the degree-one homogeneous Lambda-plus-Gamma cell functional on the overlap cone. Prove for every n>=1,d>=2 that R_n,d,eps is comparable up to eps-only constants to min{1,d/[n log(ed)]}. Construct an explicit all-data estimator using a globally Lipschitz extension of the cell oracle functional, pilot-local tensor Jackson polynomials, centered factorial moments, clipping, and de-Poissonization; allow unknown unequal propensities, arbitrary cell masses, null cells, outcome-boundary means, and exact treatment-effect ties. Prove the matching all-measurable-estimator lower bound in every regime, plus uniform consistency iff d=o(n log(en)) and parametric MSE iff d=O(1). This upgrades the banked nonmatching lower-versus-d/n bracket and must independently verify the GPT-6 derivation rather than import it as theorem. Consumer: implementations of individualized optimal-treatment value estimation such as the tmle3mopttx workflow, where high-dimensional categorical adjustment and data-adaptive treatment maximization make the nonsmooth cell-value risk directly operational. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: GPT-6 derived the explicit extension g_a(u)=s(u)u_a1/max{s_a(u),eps s(u)}, agreeing with the oracle functional on the overlap cone and globally Lipschitz. A tensor Jackson convolution supplies, for the same pilot-local polynomial, vertex-adaptive pointwise error and an exponential centered-monomial coefficient envelope. Centered Poisson factorial identities, local clipping, integrated pilot tails, and Poisson coupling then give the d/[n log(ed)] upper contribution without cross-cell covariance; an exact Poisson moment-matching splice gives the matching dense converse. Null cells, overlap boundaries, unequal masses, exact ties, saturation, and superpolynomial n relative to d were stress-checked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: No hard lemma was left open, but D0 must independently verify the combined Jackson coefficient bookkeeping, local pilot scale, clipping variance, de-Poissonization, and all-regime lower splice. EARLY KILL TEST: Verify Sections 2-6 together; stop or pivot if one Jackson polynomial cannot satisfy both displayed approximation and coefficient bounds, or if pilot failures lose their local sqrt(p_x L/m)+L/m scale. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/stat_discrete_optimal_value_minimax_gpt6.md.

seed_details.parent_claim: The parent proves \(c_\epsilon\min\{1,\sqrt d/n+d/[n\log(en)]\}\leq\mathfrak R_{n,d,\epsilon}\leq\min\{1,C_\epsilon d/n\}\), and matching achievability and the intermediate consistency region remain open.
seed_details.upgrade_move: The parent has only empirical-ratio achievability at \(d/n\); this run defines \(\widehat V_{n,d}^{\mathrm{JF}}\) and asks for the uniform finite-sample rate \(d/[n\log(ed)]\), a matching converse, and exact consistency and parametric boundaries.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Close the unrestricted binary-treatment optimal-value minimax bracket under fixed overlap without minimum cell mass, a margin condition, known propensities, or interior outcome means.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Extend the observational cell oracle from the overlap cone to the whole nonnegative orthant before approximation, then convolve that extension with one tensor Jackson kernel whose pointwise and centered-coefficient bounds are proved jointly.
seed_details.axis_rubric_check: The named estimator \(\widehat V_{n,d}^{\mathrm{JF}}\) has a stated uniform convergence rate for the parent's sharp scalar target and therefore satisfies the estimation-axis requirement.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is immediate from JiaoHanWeissman2018L1 after writing the maximum as an \(L_1\) distance.
seed_details.rebuttal: That paper's upper estimator uses two normalized probability vectors; the unrestricted causal law has unknown unequal arm denominators inside every cell, so the first missing step is a coefficient-controlled approximation on a four-dimensional overlap cone, including its vertex and off-cone pilot boxes.

seed_details.one_line: Direct-multinomial frontier: construct a deterministic fixed-multinomial centered-factorial estimator attaining \(d/[n\log(ed)]\) without Poisson subsampling or conditional randomization.
seed_details.parent_claim: The parent supplies a fixed-sample empirical-ratio estimator but no logarithmically improved estimator on the full observational class.
seed_details.upgrade_move: Replace Poisson thinning by multivariate hypergeometric splitting and control the resulting cross-cell covariance directly at the matched rate.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Obtain a practically direct estimator for the same parent target while retaining exact fixed-sample risk.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace independent Poisson cell blocks by negatively dependent multinomial factorial statistics and establish a covariance inequality after pilot-dependent clipping.
seed_details.axis_rubric_check: The move names a deterministic estimator and the same target rate, so it passes the estimation rubric if its covariance theorem is established.
seed_details.referee_objection: Rao--Blackwellization already makes the Poisson-subsampled construction deterministic, so removing its latent randomization is only computational packaging.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for statistical novelty; a direct formula may matter computationally but is not a separate field-level kernel.

seed_details.one_line: Local-moment reconstruction frontier: estimate grouped four-cell intensity measures by cell-preserving local moment matching and plug the Lipschitz ratio maximum into the reconstruction.
seed_details.parent_claim: The parent identifies the four-cell ratio cone but its attempted polynomial branch fails at simultaneous approximation and coefficient control.
seed_details.upgrade_move: Replace explicit cellwise polynomials by a grouped local-moment program and seek the same \(d/[n\log(ed)]\) risk for the parent's oracle value.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Adapt the universality of local moment matching to a functional that depends on labelled four-tuples rather than an unlabeled probability multiset.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The local reconstruction must preserve within-cell treatment--outcome labels and the common mass normalization, whereas the exemplar reconstructs an unlabeled scalar multiset.
seed_details.axis_rubric_check: The proposed grouped reconstruction is a named estimator with a target convergence rate.
seed_details.referee_objection: HanJiaoWeissman2018Local already estimates every Lipschitz functional after reconstructing the sorted distribution.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its symmetry quotient discards which four intensities belong to the same confounder cell; restoring that grouping is the entire causal ratio problem, and no located theorem controls the resulting product measure at the required rate.

seed_details.one_line: Sharp constant frontier: characterize and attain the \(\epsilon\)-dependent asymptotic constant after the matched rate fixes the correct normalization.
seed_details.parent_claim: The parent leaves exact constants open but its proposed \(n\log n/d\) normalization diverges below its logarithmic-square elbow.
seed_details.upgrade_move: Use the corrected \(n\log(ed)/d\) normalization and derive a cone-constrained approximation--moment dual whose value is attained by an estimator.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine the exact local asymptotic minimax geometry of the observational four-cell overlap cone.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: First prove that the corrected normalization is uniformly rate-valid, then identify equality between the local approximation primal and overlap-preserving moment dual.
seed_details.axis_rubric_check: Attainment requires a named asymptotically minimax estimator, but the rate theorem must precede the constant calculation.
seed_details.referee_objection: An exact-constant program is premature until the parent bracket is closed.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the first version; the constant is retained as the required open-ended question after the matched-rate theorem, not as the headline kernel.
